newsitem.title: UK: Reckitt rises after positive press comment.
newsitem.headline: Reckitt rises after positive press comment.

text.p: Shares in Reckitt and Colman Plc advanced 14 pence to 801 following bullish newspaper comments on the household products group's 1996 results, which were released yesterday, market makers said.
"Reckitt and Colman has wiped aways its dusty old image over the past two years, to attractive takeover target," the Financial Times' influential Lex Column said.
Reckitt and Colman on Thursday reported an 11 percent rise in in 1996 pre-tax profits to 316.5 million stg, seeing similar growth this year.

"Given strong fundamentals, strong growth in America and strong progress in Europe and the focus on shareholder value, there are strong reasons for favouring the stock," said analyst Alex Isaac at Panmure.
